punchline: One of Kotter's CEOs engineered the largest accounting loss in company history to get people moving.
thirty_sec: John Kotter watched more than 100 companies try to change. The first mistake on his list is too little urgency, and well over half failed there. In the better cases leaders showed people the unpleasant facts: one CEO engineered a record accounting loss, and a division president published customer surveys he knew would be terrible.
